Rugby union and rugby league look similar but have important differences. Rugby union has 15 players per side, while rugby league has 13. In union, play often includes rucks, mauls, lineouts, and more contesting for possession after tackles. prompt.content: What’s the difference between a thesis statement and a topic sentence?

A thesis statement gives the main idea of an entire essay. It usually appears near the end of the introduction and tells the reader what the essay will explain, argue, or analyze.
